cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Reveal the Truth in Layers
cards.instruction: Protect someone by disclosing the truth in stages, changing what each earlier statement appears to mean.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The wedding venue has made a small change.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. The date remains available. The building does not.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A fire. Let's hold onto the available date while we choose what comes next.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 calls loss small change and A3 distinguishes date from building; A5 offers shared next choice, but actual status beyond prefacing is weak and protective purpose only inferred.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2 what changed with staged availability; A5 answers B4 cause explicitly with fire and returns to date.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks nature of change and B4 asks cause, plausible person receiving bad venue news.

heightening.evidence: A5 fire reveals seriousness but protective leadership ends in broad choose-next language.

specificity.evidence: A1 wedding venue and A3 unavailable building give clear stakes; A5 fire supplies cause.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 prefatory demand to wait contradicts immediately answering without adding a useful method.
